mostWorthwhile.text: Making the new stellar nursery brought the chapter’s scattered products together and gave the stellar lifecycle a compelling consequence.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making light felt like a detour, and turning the remnant into a nebula did not explain what role the light played.

surprise.text: The fusing core and supernova explanations clarified that massive stars make heavier elements and that only some stars end in this kind of explosion.

arbitrary.text: Light’s combination with the expanding remnant felt arbitrary: I followed the only available option without understanding why light was needed.

continue.text: Yes. The nursery’s promise of future rocky worlds makes me curious to see how the inherited material develops, despite the unclear light step.
